title: Chapter 396 Mysterious Ancient City
content:
Chapter 396 Mysterious Ancient City

Everyone heard Lu Daosheng say, "What, the Human Emperor was confused as soon as he left? Is this the human race led by the Human Emperor?"

Lu Daosheng's words made everyone lower their heads unconsciously.

Everyone present was the pride of the world, and they had no idea how much effort they had, so they got here step by step.

The same is that they have all received help from the Human Emperor, or inherited part of the Human Emperor's inheritance, and came here under the guidance of the Human Emperor.

When they learned that the world was about to collapse, they joined the team to jointly resist out-of-bounds erosion without hesitation.

It can be said that it is the existence of the Human Emperor that tightly tied the strong men who were not acquainted and existed in all worlds.

But now, the Human Emperor is gone.

The human race seems to have once again ushered in the crisis of impending division.

And Lu Daosheng would never allow such a thing to happen.

The world is in a crisis at this moment, so there is no energy to split.

He must let these human powerhouses know what they should do now.

Buzz —

In an instant, the power in Lu Daosheng's body suddenly spread like a tide, constantly eroding the horror on everyone's faces.

The power of this force made the entire universe boom.

Countless ancient houses were shaking.

Many ancient and powerful auras rose out, and their spiritual senses came towards them.

The reason why the Human Emperor can lead the human race and even have a huge position in the boundaries of the universe is that in addition to the unrivalled prestige of the Human Emperor, is because of the Human Emperor's powerful strength.

It can be said that if the Human Emperor was in his heyday, no one would be his opponent in the entire universe's boundary.

Since that's the case, Lu Daosheng chose to use his absolute strength to convince the public.

This is also the most convenient way at present.

At this moment, all the strong men of the entire human race stared at Lu Daosheng tightly.

In the eyes, there are shock, excitement, complexity, hope, and worry.

At this time, an old voice sounded from a huge ancient house, the size of the ancient house was second only to the ancient house where the Human Emperor was.

"I wonder if you are an enemy or a friend?"

Faced with this question, all living beings in the boundary of the universe held their breath and waited for Lu Daosheng's answer.

"friend."

Lu Daosheng spoke without hesitation.

Hearing this answer, the sentient beings breathed a sigh of relief.

They could not imagine what terrifying consequences would be if Lu Daosheng was the enemy.

Although this possibility is small, it is not without it.

Because of the boundaries of the universe, there were rebels, who were crazy and paranoid, hoping that the world would be destroyed.

They believe that after the world is destroyed, a new life will come.

How can such a ridiculous statement be recognized by everyone?

So those people were directly suppressed and blood sprinkled in the stars.

However, Lu Daosheng's next words shocked the sentient beings again.

"Human Emperor, I am a close friend. From now on, I will control the human race."

As soon as these words were said, all living beings were full of thoughts.

Although in the face of the current world crisis, race abandons past grudges, unites and faces them together, they are actually thinking about the future in private.

It is unrealistic to make them give everything without reservation now.

It is a helpless move for the Human Emperor to sacrifice his life to delay the countdown to the world.

After all, the Human Emperor was the first to stand up, and it has been a miracle to persevere until now.

Now that the Human Emperor has left, the human race has no leader. If some of the strong people of the human race can be absorbed at this time, and the crisis will be resolved one day in the future, the benefits they will receive will definitely be great.

Of course, they only dared to think about this idea. Lu Daosheng's appearance killed their fantasy in the cradle.

Based on Lu Daosheng's strength, no one in the universe spoke out against it.

With the support of everyone, Lu Daosheng returned to the ancient house where the Human Emperor once was.

When he returned to the ancient house again, Lu Daosheng looked carefully and then he realized that the universe was hidden in the ancient house.

"Everything comes back."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand behind him.

Everyone looked at each other and left silently.

Suddenly, the ancient house became quiet in an instant, leaving only Lu Daosheng standing in front of the chair representing supreme identity, dazed.

"Human Emperor, you call yourself my student, but why do I have no impression of you?"

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself.

After a moment of silence, he called out in his heart: "System?"

At this moment, the system fell into silence again.

Lu Daosheng was not lost, but felt a sense of being taken for granted.

It seems that I am not far from discovering the truth.

At this time, Lu Daosheng noticed that there seemed to be room for the chair.

With doubt, Lu Daosheng walked around the chair and continued to walk forward.

As Lu Daosheng deepened, the surrounding space gradually changed.

A buzzing sound.

The surroundings suddenly turned into stars.

The law of the great way of branches tangled around Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng did not resist this.

Because he felt that these laws were left by the Human Emperor, and he seemed to want to take him to somewhere.

Time passed slowly, and Lu Daosheng was shining with dazzling light.

When his vision was clear, Lu Daosheng had already arrived in an ancient city.

"here it is?"

Lu Daosheng frowned and looked at the dilapidated ancient city. He actually felt familiar.

In order to understand where this place was, Lu Daosheng raised his foot and headed towards the depths of the ancient city.

After walking for a while, Lu Daosheng's speed was getting faster and faster, and he came to a huge gate.

Above the door, there is a big word engraved - City.

There were some traces vaguely visible on the side of this character. It seemed that there was a character in front of the character Cheng, but it had been blocked by indescribable means.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng frowned even tighter.

He continued to go deep into the city.

As Lu Daosheng became deeper and deeper, his familiar aura became stronger and stronger.

Until, a large temple appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng looked at the two figures on both sides of the temple. To be precise, they were two corpses.

I don't know how long these two corpses have been dead, but they are still sitting on both sides, lifelike, as if they are guarding the temple.

Lu Daosheng was silent and walked into the temple.

What caught my eye was a statue.

The statue is nothing else, it is Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the statue in front of him, Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and suddenly smiled, "Let me guess that the owner of this city is actually me, and the statue in front of him is my previous life."

"So smart."

As soon as Lu Daosheng finished speaking, a sound came from the statue.

The next moment, with a click, the statue cracked open, and an illusory figure slowly walked out of the statue.
